text:
Ava (product): Quick sync — Helios requested a private pilot (VPC) with 99.9% latency SLO for chat endpoints and HSM-backed keys. They want pilot week of Apr 18. Need cross-team owners and sequencing (runtime prewarm, dedicated pool, KMS/HSM, security review). Who can take the infra-runtime handshake?

Raj (eng): We need a dedicated GPU pool + prewarm. Realistically 2 weeks to allocate + basic validation. Who owns the KMS/HSM integration?

Maya (runtime): Can we reuse the adaptive prewarm from mux? I’ll need warmup scripts, batching config, and a quant profile for the model. Also need to know sequence lengths they expect.

Luis (infra): We can provision dedicated nodes in the customer's VPC but need a reserved capacity commit (sales sign-off). Also need network ACLs and routing rules—shouldn’t block timeline but ~10 days after sign-off.

Nora (security): HSM onboarding requires a compliance review and an HSM integration checklist. Expect 1 sprint for review + threat model. No plaintext key material on hosts — KMS proxy only.

Sam (solutions): @Ava I’ll confirm Helios readiness and their acceptance criteria. They said they can be flexible by +/-1 week, but budget needs to be cleared.

Ava (product): Action items proposal: Raj -> canary/fallback plan + own runtime rollout; Luis -> provision infra; Nora -> run security/compliance and HSM onboarding; Maya -> prewarm/batching/quant profile. Can we capture a minimal rollout checklist here?

Raj (eng): Minimal rollout checklist:
```
- provision dedicated pool
- deploy model:v2 (customer-quantized)
- enable prewarm and KV cache
- run synthetic load (50 qps baseline)
- start canary 5% -> 25% -> 100% with 48h monitoring windows
- fallback path to hosted variant if errors > 0.5% or p99 > SLO
```

ops-bot: Deploy scheduler: Canary window tentatively scheduled Apr 18 02:00-06:00 UTC (owner: Raj).

Raj (eng): Add metrics schema we need: p50/p95/p99 token latency, error rate (5xx/timeout), tokens/sec, cost/token. Also need a flag to disable caching during canary for tests.

Maya (runtime): Estimate: 3 days to wire batcher config + KV caching hooks. Quant profile requires a 48h eval run with representative prompts — I can deliver that by next Tue if dataset is ready.

Luis (infra): I'll start the VPC ACL template and a provisioning ticket. Need sales confirmation and the customer subnet CIDRs by EOD Wed.

Nora (security): I'll draft the HSM integration checklist and threat model template today. If Helios needs FIPS/HSM attestation, that adds dependence on vendor docs — call that out to customer.

Ava (product): Great. I'll consolidate action items and send a short plan to exec for budget approval. Will cc infra + security. If anything blocks, ping #eng-oncall and @ops-bot. :thumbsup:

Raj (eng): Sounds good. @Maya once you have the quant perf numbers, we should run a low-traffic smoke run before canary.

Maya (runtime): Will do — I'll post the eval results in this thread.

Sam (solutions): I'll confirm customer acceptance criteria and share any required test prompts/config by tomorrow.

Ava (product): Thanks all — I'll update the shared doc with owners and timeline by EOD.
